about_the_game:
Battle of Nowhere throws you into a relentless VR battlefield where every second counts. Armed with upgradeable weapons and lightning-fast reflexes, you must survive wave after wave of undead chaos.

This is not your average shooter—this is an adrenaline-pumping, zombie-blasting, VR arcade experience designed for players who crave intensity and precision.

Key Features

  • Fast-Paced VR Combat: Dodge, shoot, and slash in heart-racing close-quarters encounters.

  • Tactical Weapon Upgrades: Enhance your guns, knives, and explosives to match your playstyle.

  • Dynamic Enemy Waves: Face off against swarms of enemies with evolving attack patterns.

  • Boss Fights That Push You to the Limit: Every few waves, a monstrous boss will test your skill, timing, and strategy.

  • Replayability with Leaderboards: Climb the ranks and prove your worth in global scoreboards.

Whether you're slicing through enemies with a souped-up combat knife or detonating barrels for explosive multikills, Battle of Nowhere delivers nonstop thrills built from the ground up for VR.

It’s you vs. the apocalypse—are you fast enough to survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • VR Support: OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: Supports Value Index, Quest series, HTC VR headset series, and any other VR headsets that support OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i9 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • VR Support: OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: Supports Value Index, Quest series, HTC VR headset series, and any other VR headsets that support OpenXR

short_description: A fast-paced VR arcade shooter where you fight off relentless zombie hordes with upgradeable weapons, explosive traps, and lightning reflexes. Survive the apocalypse — or die trying.
